company.name: Flower Company
company.shortDescription: Flower Company is a cannabis wholesale membership club.
company.description:
FLOWER CO is a cannabis wholesale membership club that saves members 40% on popular brands and products, delivered to your door. They work with small business in each market to get a product to you and they believe that the modern cannabis economy can be an equalizing force that provides high-quality jobs.

The company currently delivering to recreational and medicinal users across Alameda country, Vallejo, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Sacramento, and Marin. Their business model delivers premium products to consumers directly from the old-school supply at wholesale prices.

FLOWER CO was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Arcata, California.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $16,000,000, or 84.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,151,547 to $79,994,503, a 25.38x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 63 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
